findings.comment: Landscape and exhibit sheets (Existing Tree Plan, Landscape Plan, Tree List, Canopy Impact Exhibit, Root Zone Impact Exhibit, Landscape Calculations, Biofiltration Pond Plans, Landscape Details) are numbered as sheets 30-37 on the cover sheet index but show numbering as 27-34 of 35 in their individual title blocks, indicating inconsistent sequential numbering.

The 'Y' total sheet count in the X of Y format is inconsistent across the plan set. Sheets 1-29 and sheets 38-39 show 'of 39', while landscape sheets 30-37 show 'of 35'. The cover sheet index indicates 39 total sheets, but landscape sheets reference a 35-sheet total.

Sheet index on the cover sheet lists sheets 30-37 with sequential numbering as 'Existing Tree Plan', 'Landscape Plan', 'Tree List', etc., but individual sheets display different numbering (27-34 of 35) in their title blocks, creating a mismatch between index and actual sheet identification.

Landscape sheets are not properly integrated into the overall sequential whole-number numbering system. Although listed as sheets 30-37 in the cover sheet index, they show numbering as 27-34 of 35, indicating they were pulled from a separate document set with its own numbering sequence.
Wall Plan sheets (38-39) display an abbreviated project title '3759 VALLEY VIEW' instead of the full official project name 'Valley View Townhomes' shown on all other sheet types in the plan set.

Project title is not consistent across all sheet types. Engineering and civil sheets show 'Valley View Townhomes', while wall sheets (38-39) show only '3759 VALLEY VIEW', creating inconsistent project identification throughout the plan set.

Sheets 38-39 (Wall Plans) display '3759 VALLEY VIEW' as the project title, which does not match the official project name 'Valley View Townhomes' as recorded in the AMANDA database (SP-2025-0126C) and shown on all other sheets.
Sheets 38-39 display an incomplete street address ('3759 VALLEY VIEW') in the title block instead of the complete address '3759 Valley View Road, Austin, Texas 78704' shown on other sheets.

Street address is inconsistent across sheets. Most sheets display '3759 Valley View Road, Austin, Texas 78704', while wall sheets (38-39) show only '3759 VALLEY VIEW' without city, state, or full street name.

The cover sheet contains a blank reference field for the Integrated Pest Management Plan recorded document number. The field reads 'For Integrated Pest Management Plan, see agreement filed in document No.____________' with no actual document number filled in, rather than showing a completed reference or 'N/A'.

Title block format and content are inconsistent across the plan set. Civil and landscape sheets use Bleyl Engineering's standard vertical title block format, while wall sheets (38-39) use a completely different format with different engineering firm information, client name (Pecan Valley Homes vs. Valley View Townhomes), and professional engineer identity (Michael Ray Lynch / MLAW Engineers vs. Jason K. Rodgers / Bleyl Engineering).

Case number (SP-2025-0126C) is absent on landscape sheets (30-37) and wall sheets (38-39). All sheets must display the site plan number in the lower right corner. Civil sheets 1-29 correctly show SP-2025-0126C, but landscape and wall sheets do not.

Sheets 38-39 (Wall Plans) appear to be from a different project. The title blocks identify the project as 'Pecan Valley Homes' with engineer 'MLAW Engineers' (Michael Ray Lynch), not 'Valley View Townhomes' by Bleyl Engineering. Sheet 38 is dated 11/30/23 and Sheet 39 is dated 11/3/2015, inconsistent with the overall project submittal date of 5/20/25. These sheets should not be included in this site plan submission without proper integration and confirmation of applicability.

Submittal dates are drastically inconsistent across sheets. Cover sheet shows submittal date of 5/20/25 and engineer signature date of 2/27/26. Wall sheets show date of 11/30/23 (Sheet 38) and 11/3/2015 (Sheet 39). These date discrepancies indicate sheets from different projects or submittals have been improperly combined into a single plan set.
